name: Roslaunch with ROSbot Master
description: Restarts the ROSbot Docker ROS environment and rosserial via SSH from the exec component, then launches a ROS package via ros_bridge. Use this when you need a clean ROS environment on the ROSbot.

agent_id.description: Agent running exec and ros_bridge components

robot_host.description: SSH target for the physical ROSbot (user@host)

compose_file.description: Docker compose file on the ROSbot

roslaunch_package.description: ROS package containing the launch file

ros_launch_timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for ROS nodes to start

params.command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ${robot_host} 'docker compose -f ${compose_file} down && docker compose -f ${compose_file} up -d && sleep 15 && port=$(readlink -f /dev/serial/by-id/usb-1a86_USB_Serial-if00-port0) && rosrun rosserial_python serial_node.py $port &'
